## Pages

- [Home — AI Summoner](https://aisummoner.com/): product site homepage with a showcase (Atlas, Atlas story, custom SAT vocab cards).
- [AI Learning Atlas](https://aisummoner.com/atlas): interactive 6-month AI engineering learning map (1-day / 1-week / 1-month / 6-month zoom levels). Free. For adult learners, not for kids.
- [The Atlas Story](https://aisummoner.com/atlas-story): the article telling the Atlas story — "Midnight Silicon Bistro: a small bistro that only opens late at night, and the server is an AI."
- [Custom SAT Vocab Cards](https://buy.stripe.com/5kQ3cw8SE0PH2DI6andfG02): personalized vocab cards for your child (name + likes + hidden-cat game). Trial $9.99 tax-inclusive. Order page coming soon.
